screens.name: vscode-profile
steps: Open the folder C:\lab\pl10, dark theme, font size 18 or larger
Open profiles/slow.cpuprofile from the Explorer (written by the previous screen's command)

Frame the profile viewer: functions with their time, buildReportSlow at the top; if the built-in viewer does not appear, say so and drop this screen (Chrome DevTools > Performance can load the same file)
Open the integrated terminal and run: node --cpu-prof --cpu-prof-dir=cpuprof src/run-report.js slow 3000
mask: window title and Explorer root if they show a user name
prepare: Push-Location C:\lab\pl10; node src/cli.js profile slow --rows 3000 | Out-Null; Pop-Location
